name: Wayfarer Tongue L17: The Standing Appointment (Capstone)

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
You always have a Message. The world keeps a slot warm for you.

If at any time your Package slot is empty, the GM designates a Message that the world structurally needs delivered: a truth that is under-distributed, an apology a decade overdue, a name that must be said in a specific place, a treaty that must be witnessed by a specific person. The GM tells you the destination.

You are not obligated to carry it. Carrying it is a Message like any other — Protected Word (L9) applies, Reply With Interest (L13) applies, the L1 delivery refill applies, Package Mastery (Class Tier 3) applies.

On delivery of a Standing Appointment Message:

  • Darkness in the recipient's hex is reduced by 2 points (in addition to any other reductions).

  • The faction the recipient belongs to gains 2 Tikkun progress toward their next stage.

system.requirements: Route of the Wayfarer Tongue, Shadow Courier Initiation 17

args.body: On delivery of a Standing Appointment Message: Darkness in the recipient's hex is reduced by 2 points (in addition to any other reductions)
